title: Wray Gunn
content: At theNorman Rockwell Museumon Friday I met the gentleman who posed for Mr. Rockwell’s famous painting “New Kids in the Neighborhood.”Wray Gunn of Stockbridge was the black boy to the left of the scene. He said that many members of his family posed for Rockwell’s other paintings during this period.He showed me a series of prints of the photos that Rockwell worked from.I did a quick sketch of him in the same angle as the original picture, 41 years later. The Norman Rockwell Museum has several museum docents who are former models.
